methodology: Fresh normal-difficulty game in every catalog. Expected health/loyalty are independently derived from the pinned cnblogs reference and explicit faction context; virtue is checked against retained SAN14 numerical facts. Every city preview is compared with runtime state without RNG/save mutation, then the complete save is loaded into a fresh same-version campaign.
scope: Opening verification only, not historical certification of existing placements or a migration of older saves. Changed-person lists contain initial health/loyalty changes only; full virtue changes are in officer-stat-changes-v1.json.
